title: Work tape cell encoding
statement: Let $M$ be a deterministic Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet, let $w$ be a finite Boolean input string, and let $T,t,r$ be nonnegative integers. For a work tape $\tau$, the cell encoding at position $r-T$ consists of the Boolean indicator that the tape head is at that position, followed by the Boolean encodings of the tape symbol there and the work chain value there.
hypotheses_covered: A deterministic Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet
caveat: The snippet does not include the definition of the optional-symbol Boolean encoding used for the tape symbol and chain value.
